name: payroll document/export/statutory consistency

exact_row_definitions_inspected.workflow: 21. Payroll, Advances, Attendance, and Worker Money
exact_row_definitions_inspected.expected: Deductions apply only to intended workers using reviewed formulas.
exact_row_definitions_inspected.failure: PF/ESI enrollment gating exists, but the reviewed formulas are not consistent end-to-end. The UI preview applies employee ESIC as grossPay * 0.0075 for every enrolled worker; the settlement RPC applies ESIC only when adjusted gross is <= 21000. For an enrolled worker above that threshold, the preview and persisted settlement would disagree, so this cannot be approved as using one reviewed formula.

exact_row_definitions_inspected.workflow: 21. Payroll, Advances, Attendance, and Worker Money
exact_row_definitions_inspected.expected: Persisted gross, each deduction, adjustment, debt, and net equal preview.
exact_row_definitions_inspected.failure: Preview-versus-settlement cannot be approved from source because enrolled-worker ESIC logic diverges: UI preview deducts ESIC for every enrolled worker, while the settlement RPC only deducts ESIC when adjusted gross is <= 21000. A high-gross enrolled worker would see a preview net payout lower than the persisted settlement net payout. No live high-gross enrolled settlement was executed.

exact_row_definitions_inspected.workflow: 21. Payroll, Advances, Attendance, and Worker Money
exact_row_definitions_inspected.expected: Name, cycle, earning lines, adjustments, deductions, net, and debt are correct.
exact_row_definitions_inspected.failure: Payslip PDF does not meet the guide requirement. The PDF generator includes worker name, month, earning lines, gross, advance deduction, and net pay, but it does not render manual inam/kapaat adjustments, PF, ESI, carried-forward debt, payment mode, or explicit cycle dates. The PDF button is also available from the row action without requiring a paid settlement. WhatsApp payslip details are richer, but this item asks for the PDF.

exact_row_definitions_inspected.workflow: 21. Payroll, Advances, Attendance, and Worker Money
exact_row_definitions_inspected.expected: Search/filter, line reconstruction, totals, and filename are correct.
exact_row_definitions_inspected.failure: Settlement history search/filter, line reconstruction, totals, CSV download, and filename generation are present, but the CSV export reads PF/ESI from top-level employee_pf and employee_esic itemization fields. The latest settlement RPC persists statutory deductions as nested pf.employee and esic.employee objects, so real persisted settlements can export PF/ESI as 0 even when deducted.

PDF body text is generated via jsPDF text APIs, but payslip PDF filenames are not safely normalized: workerName.replace(/\s+/g, '_') only replaces whitespace. Worker names are not character-restricted beyond non-empty validation, so filename-hostile characters can reach doc.save. CSV export has a stricter filename sanitizer, making this inconsistent.

exact_row_definitions_inspected.expected: Today meters, production status, work risk, order/run progress, and payroll signals update once.
exact_row_definitions_inspected.failure: Production, work-risk, dispatch, and payroll-count signals are recomputed from source data, but Factory Today hard-codes grossWagesSoFar to 0. After shift production, the gross wage signal therefore cannot update once on Factory Today even though worker count and analytics worker breakdown can update elsewhere.

implementation_summary: Added a shared payroll statutory helper that applies PF on the 15000 wage ceiling and applies employee ESIC only when the adjusted gross is at or below the 21000 ESIC wage ceiling.
Moved payroll preview statutory calculations onto the shared helper so high-gross enrolled preview rows no longer deduct ESIC when the settlement formula would not.
Added a settlement itemization extractor that reads the nested persisted RPC shape pf.employee and esic.employee, while preserving legacy optimistic top-level fields as fallback.
Expanded payslip generation to include explicit cycle dates, manual inam/kapaat rows, advance recovery, PF, ESI, net pay, carry-forward debt, and payment mode.
Disabled payslip PDF generation until a row has a paid settlement, and wired PDF inputs from paid settlement values rather than unpaid preview-only values.
Sanitized payslip filenames to ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, and hyphen characters only, with path separators, traversal dots, and filename-hostile punctuation removed.
Replaced the Factory Today grossWagesSoFar placeholder with a focused read-model helper over existing production log meter/rate snapshots.
